summary_en: Year-end dividend for fiscal year 2026 October revised to 40 yen per share from 20 yen, with 20 yen ordinary dividend and 20 yen commemorative dividend for 20th anniversary. Dividend payout ratio targeting 35%, minimum annual dividend 20 yen per share during mid-term plan period through October 2028.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (20th Anniversary Commemorative Dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Tobila Systems revised its year-end dividend forecast for fiscal year ending October 2026 to 40 yen per share from the previously announced 20 yen per share. The revision comprises 20 yen as an ordinary dividend and 20 yen as a commemorative dividend marking the company's 20th anniversary.

The company stated that it had achieved strong performance through the third quarter of fiscal 2026, driven by expanded sales of TobilaFone Cloud and TobilaFone Biz products. While continuing to invest in new product development and human resources as part of its Medium-Term Management Plan 2028, the company determined that sufficient liquidity for stable operations and future growth investments could be secured with cash available for shareholder returns.

The company confirmed its dividend policy targeting a payout ratio of 35% and setting a minimum annual dividend per share of 20 yen during the medium-term plan period through October 2028. Management stated this commemorative dividend does not change the underlying dividend policy, and the company will continue prioritizing growth investments while returning excess cash to shareholders.
